test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Ravali does not have any brother. Girima is the wife of Arjun. Zakir is the husband of Malavi. Chaya is the daughter of Ravali. Fatima is the daughter of Arjun. Malavi is the mother of Ravali. Girima is the maternal aunt of Chaya. How is Girima related to Zakir?
solution:
Family chart :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ef6c12b7737ebb1affb50d2bf56d3a8472a8ad04edd22ef87d0842d0b8df3bb.png] 

1) Zakir is the husband of Malavi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db24c166376b86eca076d06287b1aa7570828207b35d926eebcbe185723fa2bb.png] 

2) Malavi is the mother of Ravali.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a22e3fdffae25c4919780773aa36c4f9e131f98ceca13975cdbf1f344bbec93.png] 

3) Chaya is the daughter of Ravali.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cff55e7d5d33e2082c2d1e1a40775872b0f124f3f4041982d72f25910476af6.png] 

4) Girima is the maternal aunt of Chaya and Ravali does not have any brother.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d031be64b0875ed3aa725834bbf2367b393cdb1bc83c47da70846b09fc8aa266.png] 

5) Girima is the wife of Arjun and Fatima is the daughter of Arjun.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac0a0a2d988b2ed14e0e8d0856404f340fe1c3d829e71b1529943e78c9723ea1.png] 

∴ Here, Girima is 'daughter' of Zakir.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Daughter".**
